name: CTF-1: triazine and phenylene, large
description: A covalent triazine framework of the CTF-1 kind: s-triazine rings linked through para-phenylene (1,4-benzene), strictly alternating (triazine to phenylene only), as from the trimerisation of 1,4-dicyanobenzene. Built large: a 60 A cell with 8 seeds, then ten passes, each growing 60 blocks, joining clusters twice (moving whole clusters to bond them to each other, so the seeds' clusters become one or two large frameworks), zipping and a rigid-body optimisation with dihedrals (GAFF 1.81, params/gaff_ctf); then Poreblazer on a 0.3 A grid (about 340 MB). Sized for a Slurm node (resources); sweep the cell size or grow counts to go larger. See docs/ctf-networks.md.
